# Exercise employee stock options

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

When an option holder requests an exercise or a grant approaches a relevant exercise deadline. A verified exercise decision and, if completed, reconciled payment, issued equity and required reporting evidence.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.

> Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Reconcile the grant and the exercise request

agent-runnable


Gather the signed grant, plan, vesting history, exercise price, holder details and requested quantity. Compare records and identify post-termination, expiry or transfer restrictions for counsel to confirm.

- Sources: [IRS stock options, Topic 427](https://www.irs.gov/taxtopics/tc427) · [SEC private secondary markets](https://www.sec.gov/resources-small-businesses/capital-raising-building-blocks/private-secondary-markets)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Review eligibility, cost and tax questions

human · human approval required


The holder and company obtain their own qualified advice on the actual instrument, jurisdiction and facts. Confirm the exercise method, available quantity and required approvals without promising liquidity or selecting a tax outcome for the holder.

- Sources: [IRS stock options, Topic 427](https://www.irs.gov/taxtopics/tc427) · [SEC private secondary markets](https://www.sec.gov/resources-small-businesses/capital-raising-building-blocks/private-secondary-markets)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Prepare the approved exercise documents

agent-runnable


Populate the applicable exercise notice and calculation from verified terms. Record payment, withholding and evidence requirements and flag any difference between the grant and the company equity system.

- Sources: [IRS stock options, Topic 427](https://www.irs.gov/taxtopics/tc427) · [SEC private secondary markets](https://www.sec.gov/resources-small-businesses/capital-raising-building-blocks/private-secondary-markets)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Authorize and complete the exercise

human · human approval required


The holder and authorized company representatives review and execute the required documents. Authorized operators collect and verify the required consideration and approvals before recording an issuance; a submitted request is not completed ownership.

- Sources: [IRS stock options, Topic 427](https://www.irs.gov/taxtopics/tc427) · [SEC private secondary markets](https://www.sec.gov/resources-small-businesses/capital-raising-building-blocks/private-secondary-markets)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Reconcile issuance and follow-up obligations

agent-runnable


Match the signed exercise, payment and equity register, and retain the confirmation privately. Assign any tax, payroll or securities reporting to the appropriate advisers and update the cap table through its established process.

- Verify: A verified exercise decision and, if completed, reconciled payment, issued equity and required reporting evidence.
- Sources: [IRS stock options, Topic 427](https://www.irs.gov/taxtopics/tc427) · [SEC private secondary markets](https://www.sec.gov/resources-small-businesses/capital-raising-building-blocks/private-secondary-markets)
